absence.description: nobody present in the home or in the relevant room; ambient room sound only (HVAC, distant traffic, refrigerator hum).

calling.description: phone call — sustained one-sided speech with pauses for the remote party, typically in the living room.

cooking.description: kitchen sounds: chopping, frying, pot/pan clatter, microwave, sizzling.

dishwashing.description: running water in the sink with dishes clinking and scrubbing — manual washing-up, not a dishwasher cycle.

dressing.description: fabric rustling, zippers, drawer/wardrobe sounds, hangers — typically in the bedroom.

eating.description: cutlery on plates, chewing, glass clinks, brief speech at the table.

getting_dry.description: towel rubbing and brisk fabric-on-skin sounds after bathing.

other.description: a person IS present and active but the activity doesn't fit any of the listed categories. Includes transitions between activities, time between entering a room and starting something, sitting on the sofa, or crossing through the hall.

shaving.description: electric-razor buzz or wet-shave scraping at the sink.

showering.description: continuous water spray, often with bathroom-fan hum.

sleeping.description: a person IS present but inactive: very quiet room, slow breathing, occasional rustling. Usually a long, uninterrupted stretch.

toilet.description: toilet flush, brief water and seat sounds.

toothbrushing.description: rhythmic brushing sound, often with a sink running briefly before or after.

vacuumcleaner.description: continuous vacuum motor hum, often moving across the room. Same label regardless of which room.

visit.description: multiple voices, conversation, doorbell, footsteps — guests in the home.

watching_tv.description: TV speech, music, sound effects; periodic dialogue and music cues, often sustained.

working.description: working at a computer: keyboard typing, mouse clicks, occasional brief speech (phone or video calls).
